I implemented `minidb/tokenizer.py`, and all 22 tests in `tests/test_tokenizer.py` pass. I didn't run the integration tests.

I didn't edit the test file. It doesn't depend on any other engineer's module, so no mocking was needed.

I didn't deliberately leave out any specified behaviour, so this isn't a stripped-down version, and I haven't checked which behaviours the tests fail to cover. Whitespace skipping uses Python's `str.isspace()`, which also accepts Unicode whitespace. The tests only use ASCII whitespace, so they don't exercise that.
